label.purpose: Stat names, form labels, primary button, top bar (Forum uppercase, tracked).

shadows.name: legibility
shadows.purpose: Text shadow for the sync line over the scene.

motion.name: ease-out

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single filled gold action per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--font-display, Forum, Georgia, serif); letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; background: #cfa84e; color: #0a0b20; border: 1px solid #cfa84e; padding: 0.6rem 1.25rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #efe7cf; border-color: #efe7cf; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #cfa84e; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Default secondary control: gold hairline, fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: inherit; color: #cfa84e; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #8f7435; padding: 0.35rem 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #cfa84e; color: #0a0b20; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #cfa84e; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Gilt Frame
components.description: Hairline plate with notched corner brackets; holds the banner and stats.
components.html: Content on a plate
components.css: .ds-frame { position: relative; padding: 1rem; color: #efe7cf; background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgb(29 32 87 / 0.88), rgb(10 11 32 / 0.92)); border: 1px solid rgb(207 168 78 / 0.28); outline: 1px solid rgb(207 168 78 / 0.28); outline-offset: -7px; box-shadow: 0 1.25rem 2.5rem -1rem rgb(0 0 0 / 0.7); } .ds-c { position: absolute; width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; } .ds-tl { top: -1px; left: -1px; } .ds-br { bottom: -1px; right: -1px; transform: scale(-1); }

components.name: Stat Plaque
components.description: Engraved label over a tabular figure.
components.css: .ds-stat { display: grid; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(207 168 78 / 0.28); } .ds-stat-label { font-family: Forum, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a8a5c8; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: Forum, Georgia, serif; font-size: 2.25rem; line-height: 1.1; color: #efe7cf; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Sunken indigo well with gold-dim hairline, used for the strider name.
components.css: .ds-label { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; font-family: Forum, Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a8a5c8; } .ds-input { font: inherit; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; color: #efe7cf; background: #070818; border: 1px solid #8f7435; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #cfa84e; outline-offset: 0; }

narrative.overview:
A character sheet in an alchemist's gilt frame. Deep indigo ground, antique gold line work, pale ivory-gold text. The strider is the only subject: it stands on a summoning circle lying on the floor of a full-screen stage, and every panel is a hairline-gold plate floating over that scene. Numbers are set like engraved instruments, in a classical display face with tabular lining figures.

The mood is calm and rewarding, never loud. Nothing in the product decays, so nothing in the interface alarms; the one warning colour exists only for errors. Gold is line work and one filled action, not a surface colour. The world is recognisable with content removed by two things: the notched-corner frame and the sigil ring.

Phone and desktop are equal. Phone stacks bar, name plate, scene, then a compact 2x2 stat strip; desktop (62rem and up) moves the stats to a 22rem right column beside the scene.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only (color-scheme: dark); indigo glow pooled behind the scene, faint gold bloom at the lower left.
Hairline gilt frames with notched corner brackets; ornamental divider (diamond between two crescents).
Sigil ring: circles, a hexagram, and a slowly turning tick ring, drawn in on load.
Two faces only: Forum for display, labels and figures; Alegreya Sans for reading text.
Square-cornered controls; the only round shapes are the ring, the creature slot and the chevron buttons.

rules.name: The Gold Is Line Rule
rules.body: Gold draws edges, rules and the single filled action. It is never a large background fill.

rules.name: The One Alarm Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is the only state colour and only marks errors. Success has no colour of its own; it is calm text.

rules.name: The Engraved Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every number that reports progress uses Forum with tabular lining figures, so columns of stats align.

rules.name: The Plate Over Scene Rule
rules.body: Panels are translucent plates over the scene, never opaque cards; the ring and glow must stay visible around them.

dos: Do draw edges with hairline gold (1px at faint, dim or full strength) and corner brackets.
Do set all progress numbers in Forum with tabular lining numerals.
Do place panels as translucent plates over the stage so the ring stays visible.
Do keep copy and state calm; vermilion only for errors.
Do read colours from the custom properties in web/src/styles/tokens.css; add new values there first.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion for any new looping or drawing animation.
donts: Don't fill large areas with gold or use glossy, bevelled gold ornament.
Don't build a dark card grid with a neon accent; panels are framed plates, not cards.
Don't round control corners; circles are reserved for the ring, slot and chevron buttons.
Don't introduce a second state colour; success stays uncoloured.
